name: JackpotMC | POWER VANILLA OUT NOW!
description: JackpotMC is a server focused on PvP game modes, with our latest game mode being Lifesteal SMP. This is a one of kind, unique SMP that allows players to steal hearts from each other. Once a player kills another, they take a heart from them. If you die to a player, you lose a heart to them. Once you're out of hearts, you're banned for the rest of the day. With no claims and no rules on griefing, it is a pure Anarchy experience.
